purpose: Support hundreds of monsters with tiny variant recipes. Family profiles own reusable anatomy/identity; monster recipes contain only variant deltas, taxonomy overrides when truly needed, locomotion differences, and optional reference metadata.
rules: Every production monster recipe uses schema_version 3+ and a valid family_profile.
Family profiles own reusable species anatomy, silhouette, limb structure, surface treatment, must-keep, must-avoid, accuracy checks, known failure modes, posture, behavior style, and environment fit.
Monster recipes state only what differs from the family.
Taxonomy changes such as undead variant creature type or variant size use taxonomy_overrides instead of duplicating family anatomy.
Variant visual_overrides are for genuine variant identity such as object form, ooze geometry, equipment, or undead damage; they must not restate family anatomy.
Page recipes own the exact pose/support, environment interaction, story moment, and scene props.
Monster environment compatibility is planning-only and is never injected as generation authority after a page environment has been selected.
Reusable scenery never belongs in monster recipes.
Known family failure modes must be injected into generation and review.
scalability_rule: Hundreds of monster recipes remain small. Creature files own identity, variant traits, behavior tendencies, locomotion, and habitat compatibility; reusable scenery belongs exclusively to the environment engine.

monster_may_define: environment_compatibility as family/profile IDs or short planning tags
variant-specific environment compatibility only when the variant truly differs from its family
environment_ownership.rule: Monster compatibility is planning metadata only. Once a page selects an environment profile, the page environment is authoritative and monster data cannot rewrite the room.

recipe_limits.rule: If a recipe needs more than these limits, the reusable identity probably belongs in a family/subfamily profile instead.
